# SifuFinds — Africa's Betting Comparison Platform
> Independent resource for verified betting bonuses, licensed bookmaker reviews,
> and sports betting guides across 23 African countries. Updated daily.

## About SifuFinds
SifuFinds is Africa's #1 independent betting comparison site. We verify bonuses,
test bookmaker platforms, and publish guides for bettors across 23 African
countries. All affiliate relationships are disclosed. 18+ only.
